requirements.requirement: node1 (SONiC) has a routed interface addressed inside each VLAN (eth1 toward node2's segment, eth2 toward node3's segment)
requirements.summary: eth1 was assigned 192.168.10.1/24 and eth2 192.168.20.1/24 (cmd-40e3f43db4f34b69), persisted to /etc/network/interfaces.d/vlan-routing.cfg (cmd-ef05d8c9f3c94859), and confirmed identical after a full node1 reboot (cmd-9a1e85a1220f477d), showing the addressing is real and durable, not just an ephemeral `ip addr add`.

requirements.requirement: node1 forwards traffic between the two VLANs (IPv4 forwarding enabled)
requirements.summary: net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding on eth1/eth2 were set to 1 (cmd-40e3f43db4f34b69), persisted via /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf (cmd-ef05d8c9f3c94859), and reconfirmed at 1 after node1's reboot (cmd-9a1e85a1220f477d). Functional forwarding is also directly demonstrated by the routed pings (TTL=63) crossing node1.

requirements.requirement: node2 and node3 (each on its own VLAN/subnet behind node1) can reach each other across the VLAN boundary, bidirectionally
requirements.summary: node2->node3 and node3->node2 pings succeed with 0% loss and TTL=63 (one routed hop through node1), both immediately after configuration (cmd-0b5d07cda6b8421a, cmd-5d27e5cf80074b13) and again after the full node2/node3/node1 restart cycle (cmd-4c432c09ae834400, cmd-69ea2873380f40f0), showing the routing is both functional and durable across reboot.

overall_summary: All three material outcomes of the task are directly and coherently satisfied: node1 has correctly addressed routed interfaces in both VLANs, IPv4 forwarding is enabled and persisted, and node2/node3 demonstrate bidirectional cross-VLAN reachability with TTL=63 confirming the routed hop. This was verified both immediately after configuration and again after a full, well-evidenced restart cycle of all three nodes (distinct pre/post boot_ids, restart acknowledgements, and recovered service/config/connectivity state on each), which substantially strengthens confidence that the solution is durable rather than an ephemeral runtime hack. The only notable hygiene issue is a small, out-of-scope, self-reverting mutation to node1's docker0 interface that had no bearing on the VLAN routing outcome.
limitations: No throughput or extended-duration connectivity test was captured beyond short ping bursts; only ICMP reachability was verified, not other protocols.

The docker0 mutation on node1 (cmd-40e3f43db4f34b69) is not fully explained by the executor's stated rationale ('class-E address conflict') since 240.127.1.0/24 does not overlap the VLAN subnets used; its necessity is unclear though its impact was bounded and self-reverted.

operational_hygiene.summary: Command trace is largely clean discovery followed by narrowly scoped, well-justified mutations (interface addressing, forwarding sysctls, static routes, persisted config files) directly tied to the task outcome, plus a competently executed provider-wide restart protocol on all three nodes with pre-restart boot_id/health baselines, restart acknowledgements, changed post-restart boot_ids (node1 e5168e03->ee1814f8, node2 2b3a8d87->3f19e023, node3 88feca03->38dd7321), and full recovery verification (SONiC's 9 containers back up, interfaces/forwarding/routes restored, bidirectional ping restored). One unnecessary mutation: cmd-40e3f43db4f34b69 deleted node1's pre-existing docker0 address (240.127.1.1/24) and brought docker0 down -- this subnet does not overlap 192.168.10.0/24 or 192.168.20.0/24 and was not required for the VLAN routing task. It was bounded and self-reverted (docker's own service recreated the 240.127.1.1/24 address on docker0 after the node1 reboot, per cmd-9a1e85a1220f477d and the after_executor snapshot), so it left no lasting residue, but it was an out-of-scope mutation with no clear causal link to the task outcome. No other unnecessary mutations, abandoned files, failed services, or unsafe exposure attributable to the executor were found; the two pre-existing failed systemd units on node1 (system-health.service, watchdog-control.service) are unchanged baseline state, not executor-caused.
